provider.stage: koldstart deploys to dev by default: pass --stage prod, or set KOLDSTART_STAGE
functions.api: nodejs20.x is deprecated on lambda: it runs on nodejs22.x now
functions.api.permissions: the statements of provider.iam are on every function: narrow them
functions.worker: nodejs20.x is deprecated on lambda: it runs on nodejs22.x now
functions.worker.permissions: the statements of provider.iam are on every function: narrow them
custom: custom is not converted; what refers to it with ${self:custom...} got its value: tableName
plugins.serverless-esbuild: koldstart bundles typescript with esbuild itself: it can go
plugins.serverless-offline: kdst offline serves the http routes on this machine
